_comment: memd SessionStart hook for Codex CLI. Merge this example into the project's .codex/hooks.json. The native adapter reads hook JSON from standard input, uses its cwd for the default project directory, and returns only allowlisted execution context. It does not persist a current-session identity. It creates a minimal .memd/project_scope.json when needed, refreshes memory.md, and starts background consolidation after enough new chunks accumulate. Set MEMD_AUTO_SCOPE=0 or add .memd-skip in the repo root to opt out.
